Return api_url and web_url to their defaults. With --profile, clear that profile's settings instead,
so it falls back to the base ones.

Stored sign-ins, the default project and links are kept; to sign out, use 'voidhash logout'.

Usage:
  voidhash config reset [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help  Show help for this command

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)
